theme: Light mode primary, with dark high-contrast structural elements (sidebar/header). Industrial, high-visibility aesthetic.

headings.description: Used for all page titles, card headers, and large metric labels. Gives a sturdy, heavy-duty industrial feel.

body.description: Used for standard text, instructions, and list items.

data.description: Used for numbers, rates, box counts, and monetary values.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Performance Pro (Industrial)

visual_enhancers.borders: Use strict 1px solid borders (`border-zinc-200` or `border-zinc-300`). No soft drop shadows for cards, use sharp structural lines instead.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use hard shadows if necessary, e.g., `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]` for primary action buttons to make them tactile and 'machine-like'.
visual_enhancers.radius: Keep it sharp. Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`. Avoid pills and heavy rounding.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or diagonal hatch patterns on dark headers to feel like grip tape or industrial flooring.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High-density Grid (Mode B). Use `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4` with tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`).
layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards (`p-6` or `p-8`) to prevent text collision, but tight margins between grid items.
layouts.alignment: Left-align forms and dense data. Top-row KPI cards should use a vertical stack: Title (top left), massive number (bottom left).

components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (`border-zinc-300`), sharp corners (`rounded-none`). No shadow by default.

buttons.primary: Safety Yellow background, Black text, sharp corners. On hover: darken yellow, maybe a slight translation with hard shadow. Must be highly visible.
buttons.secondary: Outline button with thick border (`border-2 border-zinc-900`), black text. On hover: `bg-zinc-100`.

components.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn Table. `IBM Plex Mono` for numeric columns. Zebra striping (`odd:bg-zinc-50`) helps readability for long lists.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs, but force sharp corners (`rounded-none`) and thick focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-500 focus:border-transparent`).
components.alerts: Use Shadcn Alert, but style with high-contrast colors (e.g., Red bg with White text for errors).

motion.hover_states: High contrast shifts. E.g., text color changes on hover, or background goes from white to solid black with white text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA. Black text on Safety Yellow is highly accessible. Avoid light grey text on white.
accessibility.focus: Clear, thick focus rings for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="report-box-submit"`).

image_urls.description: Warehouse workers handling boxes. Use as a background image for the login screen, with a heavy dark or yellow overlay.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/bold variants) or Heroicons for a clean, utilitarian look. Install via `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` or `yarn add @heroicons/react`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Dashboard for Admin and a separate View/Dashboard for Workers.
For the Login screen, use the provided warehouse image with a dark overlay (`bg-zinc-950/80`) and a high-contrast login card.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings and KPI numbers.
Use 'IBM Plex Mono' for all data, rates, box counts, and money.
Admin Dashboard: Show Global Rate setter, total boxes processed this week, and a dense table of workers with PDF export buttons.
Worker Dashboard: Form to report boxes (daily), and a summary of their own weekly totals.
Avoid Shadcn defaults where they conflict: replace rounded corners with `rounded-none`, and use sharp, high-contrast borders.
Avoid all purple/AI-slop gradients. Use solid colors: Zinc-950, Zinc-100, White, and Yellow-500.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and sharp borders.
Use solid industrial colors. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp utilitarian buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing for padding inside containers, but keep grids dense.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (Note: use .js extension, not .tsx).
